options.description: Draw with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says of `env` and `platform`, since block elements and braille are not safe where box drawing is not.
options.name: ascii

options.description: The environment to read the terminal from. Defaults to `process.env`.
options.name: env

options.description: The value drawn as the top. Defaults to the largest value.
options.name: max

options.description: The value drawn as the bottom. Defaults to the smallest value.
options.name: min

options.description: The platform to detect for. Defaults to `process.platform`.
options.name: platform

options.description: Which role colours the data. Defaults to `accent`.
options.name: role

options.description: The most columns to draw. A longer series is cut to its **latest** values, since a sparkline is a trend and the end of it is the part that is news.
options.name: width

api.signature: function sparkline(values: readonly number[], opts?: SparklineOptions): string

registryDescription: Charts: a sparkline, horizontal and vertical bars, a braille line chart and a gauge
